newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Invest raises dividend, profits.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Invest raises dividend, profits.

text.p: Closed-end fund Hellenic Investments said its 1996 profits rose 4.9 percent to 3.42 billion drachmas from 3.26 billion a year earlier.
"Considering the difficult market conditions that prevailed in the Athens bourse last year the results are quite satisfactory," it said.
The fund saw trading profits rise by 18 percent to 2.47 billion from 2.1 billion drachmas in 1995.
"Despite an increase in income from dividends, total portfolio income slipped to 1.62 billion drachmas from 1.66 billion a year earlier mainly due to the sharp fall in interest rates," it said.
The fund's board declared a net dividend per share of 250 drachmas for fiscal 1996, up 10 drachmas on 1995.
Based on its close on Friday at 2,120 drachmas the fund's shares have a dividend yield of 11.8 percent.
As regards the fund's performance in the first month of 1997, its portfolio has unrealised capital gains over 2.0 billion drachmas, it said.
Hellenic Investments is run by fund manager Costis Morianos.
